name: Omi
source:
An old-timer of the Gohongatana Clan, he is Shigure's right-hand man and participates in planning, managing clan members, and executing military operations. 
Although he is wary of outsiders and it's not easy to win his trust, he can be described as a giant with a gentle heart and is easily moved to tears, which makes him a target of Shigure's teasing every time. 
He is a stable presence who provides invaluable moral support to Shigure and is deeply trusted by him in return.
